body.name: Induced factual-record law
body.construction: For every \((u_0,\ldots,u_T)\in\mathcal O^{T+1}\), define \[\Pr_{P,\rho,b,o}(E_T=(u_0,\ldots,u_T))=\sum_{s_{0:T}\in\mathcal S^{T+1}}\rho(s_0)\prod_{t=1}^T P(s_t\mid s_{t-1},b(s_{t-1}))\prod_{t=0}^T\mathbf 1\{o(s_t)=u_t\}.\] This law is common to every \(q\in\Theta(P)\).
